method: Fixed total samples128 times candidates and separately total2000ms soft deadline; 75% training and 25% independent paired evaluation. Same horizon, reward, candidates and original policy. Three serial timed repeats on one recorded case, no tournament.
caveats: Twenty small synthetic oracle positions predate this change but are easy; not playing-strength evidence.
Same-state repeated timing is not independent game-level evidence.
Paired candidate values/utility errors come from the independent evaluation phase only. Candidate visits and total counters include both phases.
Complete evaluation rounds may exceed the soft deadline; forced actions skip sampling.
